projects.name: Trusearch - Enterprise Search for CMS
projects.stack: Java (Quarkus), OpenSearch, Redis, Postgres, SQLite, S3, Cognito, CloudFront, EC2, Docker Compose

bullets.text: Took over [Trusearch](https://www.drupalreleases.com/project/search-api-trusearch)'s agent-first codebase and led a team of 5 to bring it to production readiness, owning architecture, client requirements, deployment decisions, and sprint delivery.

**Team Management:** Streamlined feature delivery through sprint planning, architecture guidance and blocker resolution. Aligned developers, QA, and DevOps across testing and deployment. Led client discussions throughout onboarding & go-live.

**Harness Engineering**: Tackled agentic bottlenecks like oversized PRs and context loss problems through spec-driven development, PR limits, and persistent repository memory. Automated agent reviews with human-in-the-loop oversight. Mandated walkthroughs & QA checks to validate code quality and developer understanding.

**RAG:** Built AI Overview with GPT 5.6-luna to summarize top-k search results with source citations and conversion-focused CTAs. Also evaluated a self-hosted open-weight alternative, Granite 4.1-8B, using vLLM on EC2.
**MCP Integration:** Built a tenant-scoped MCP server to let clients query their analytics and search their content daily within the Claude conversation.

**Architecture:** Designed a privacy-first architecture with the search engine and indexed content hosted in client infrastructure, alongside a centralized platform for tenants, plans, and usage limits. Led a low-code widget builder serving JS/CSS through S3 + CloudFront for website integration, and guided marketing on Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

**Search Engineering:** Led one-click integration that indexes ~10000 documents in 3 minutes & initializes widgets to make Search available instantly. Built hybrid retrieval combining BM25, HNSW dense vectors, and neural sparse search, supporting typeahead and suggestions at **p95 <300 ms**. Addressed a 10x latency after reranking through Caffeine L1 caching.

projects.name: Grower App
projects.stack: Java (Quarkus), Hibernate, Blaze Persistence, Flutter, MySQL, Python (FastAPI), Pandas, SciPy

bullets.text: Owned design and delivery of India's first [Smart Grower App](https://www.livine.io/grower-app) (Flutter+Quarkus) aimed at automating Breeder operations, reducing manual labour and providing real-time analytics & projections.
**Client Engagement:** Led the entire process from requirement gathering to on-site implementation, from guiding users to troubleshooting issues and all further client communication & feedback loop.

**Data processing:** Phone sits in your pocket and reads values from a scale over BLE protocol & uses **_Sliding-window Standard Deviation_** approach to capture stable weights automatically (~200ms interval). Eliminated the need for a separate person who records weights on paper.

**Offline operation & Concurrency:** Designed a fail-proof offline-first weighing to make up for poor farm connectivity and speed up processing **_(~3s per bird)_**. Batch-wise syncing once good connectivity is detected. Enabled 10+ concurrent users to process up to **_50k birds per day_** per farm.

**Predictive Analytics:** Solved a real bottleneck with instant analytics as soon as data is synced, replacing a manual process that took until evening or next day. Built a Gompertz-based growth model using SciPy curve fitting to generate farm-specific weekly body weight targets.

projects.name: Finance Module
projects.stack: Java (Quarkus), Hibernate, Blaze Persistence, MySQL, Cognito, SNS, SQS, AWS Textract, Bedrock

bullets.text: Led a team of 3 to build the ERP’s Accounting module from scratch, owning client requirements, solution design, sprint planning and delivery.

**Event-driven:** Integrated the ERP with the accounting module using AWS SNS/SQS to asynchronously consume Purchase/Sale events to generate corresponding Journal entries. Eliminates manual re-entry into another software like Tally.

**PDF Extraction:** Built a cost-effective alternative to third-party statement processing software using **_AWS Textract+Claude on Bedrock_**. Automated statement extraction and Payment/Receipt entry creation.

**Webhooks:** Designed a pluggable provider **_SPI_** to support payment webhooks, automating Receipt entries from providers like Greenorange, Razorpay etc., with signature verification & idempotency.
Led hiring efforts across multiple roles during this time.

**Multi-tenancy:** Solved a painful scaling problem in managing 300+ business reports across multiple clients by building a multi-tenant React + Quarkus platform, enabling client-specific module/category activation and one-click updates across tenants.

**OLAP Migration:** Relieved pressure on MySQL by offloading read-heavy reporting to ClickHouse, cutting report latency from _**>1 minute to 2–3 seconds**_ and infrastructure costs by an estimated 40–60%.

**DB Performance**: Tried multiple ways to optimize querying with views, pre-aggregated tables with scheduled jobs, partitioning etc. Eventually also came up with a FastAPI Microservice using Pandas for advanced reporting.
Built 300+ business reports & dashboards over a span of 1.5 years.
Led application modernization by migrating users to Azure B2C for identity management, leveraging Azure IAM and Salesforce Marketing Cloud for all types of customer interactions.
Involved in DevOps processes such as building CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and setting up Splunk to enhance application monitoring & debugging capabilities.
